WHAT WE DO

A robot in the field. AI at your desk.

Some tasks need a robot and a camera. Others need good software. We work on both, and connect them when it makes sense.

01 / ROBOTICS

Robots that see and work

Robotics has many uses: sorting, moving objects, field work and agriculture. We develop robotic software and computer vision around the task, the equipment and the conditions the robot needs to work in.

SortingObject handlingField work
How we get started

First we look at the task, environment and equipment. We collect examples, build a prototype and test what works and what needs more work. We also use ROS / ROS2 to connect and control robots.

What we’re developing ↗
02 / ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE

Less work at your keyboard

Searching documents, connecting data and repeating steps between apps. AI can help you get this done without doing it all by hand each time.

DocumentsDataYour apps
Your data, your control

The assistant uses sources it is allowed to access. You can check where an answer came from and approve important actions. It can run locally or in the cloud.

See an AI example ↗
03 / SOFTWARE & SUPPORT

Keep it running

Robots and AI need reliable software. We handle setup, connections and monitoring, on a local computer or in the cloud.

LocalCloudSupport
Beyond the first launch

We track errors, set up backups and make updates easier. We document the system so you can understand and maintain it.

Let’s talk about it ↗

AI-BOOST · ROBOTICS IN AGRICULTURE

Tell the robot what needs doing.

In AI-BOOST, we are developing a way to give an agricultural robot a job in everyday language. AI should turn that instruction into a plan the robot can carry out. Our proposal was selected for the competition’s ADVANCE phase.

About the AI-BOOST competition ↗
SELECTED FOR ADVANCEAI-BOOST

CHALLENGE 1 / AGRICULTURAL ROBOTICS

  1. 01

    You describe the job

    What the robot should do, and where.

  2. 02

    Using only actions that this robot can perform.

  3. 03

    Review, then start

    The plan is checked. If something is not possible, the system should tell you clearly.

Prototype in development

We’re working on planning and checks. Testing on the target robot is still ahead.

ON OUR WORKBENCH

From the first recording to a robot task.

These are some of the problems we’re working on. We build prototypes, collect data and learn from testing.

ROBOTICS / TRANSPARENT OBJECTS

How does a robot see clear glass?

Glass reflects light and can blend into the background. We collect recordings and develop ways for a robot to locate an object and choose where to grasp it.

AI / SOFTWARE

Less copying between apps.

We’re working on assistants that find information and help with the next step in an app. You check the answer and decide what happens next.

AI FOR DOCUMENTS / EXAMPLE

Ask instead of searching.

A contract, a manual or a folder full of documents. An assistant finds what you need and shows you where it’s written, so you can check the answer yourself.
